reason: It is all about letters, measurements and a business card. I run a company of 10 to 50 people and I want to see who they have already done this for and what happened to their sales. Nothing here tells me that, and it does not say where they are based.
objection: Who are the real clients behind this, and where are they? A slick carousel about kerning does not prove they can make my business look trustworthy to my customers.
would_change_my_mind: Named clients in my kind of business, with before and after results and a local office or a phone number I can call and visit.
